text: Based on the evidence, we cannot certify with absolute certainty that no fire occurred on the asset during the period. While NASA FIRMS detected no thermal anomalies within the asset boundaries from October 6 to November 5, 2026, the sensors may have missed small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires. The data also does not confirm the presence or absence of burned areas or the cause of any potential changes. Observability was complete, with all sensors covering the asset daily, but limitations in detection capabilities mean residual uncertainty remains.
